item.title: Ralliston's Journey through all of the 001 proposals - Part Six - Jim North's Proposal
item.content:encoded:
Review: Ah, I love this one so much. Sure, it's self-inserty1, goofy, and is pretty much the embodiment of the "let's make major characters 001s" trope, but it radiates such good and creative energy I can't just not like it. It might not fit so much into the 001 slot, but hey, I don't care. It was a fun read that exploited its format screw to the fullest, and I enjoyed it, so what can I complain about?

Result: +1

Footnotes
1. Even though that's its point, I know.

item.title: Re: +1
item.content:encoded: Well I hate fun! That's why I wrote this, to get rid of all the excess fun in my system. Bar Hurmburg!

I'm gonna give this a +1. Not well-versed on the whole Wondertainment…verse(?), but this fits well into what I do know of it.

I saw a lot of complaints about this not being fitting for a 001, since it's not some Earth-shattering thing that created all SCPs/the Foundation/the multiverse etc. But that's what I like about it. There's no rule that 001s have to be the source of that is Weird and Wrong in the world, and the comparative banality of this proposal is something I really love. It hints that, perhaps, DW led to everything else. But that's almost certainly a mere tale, something they made up because it was fun.

In short, this was just really fun. I like fun.

item.content:encoded:
Vend-a-Friend, along with being a most excellent read, was actually one of the primary inspirations for making this article! Originally I was thinking about trying to start up a new series of Little Misters (they would have been Little Misses because I am super-creative), and the plan for one of the accompanying tales would have been Isabel heading down to the factory floor to brainstorm ideas with some of the common workers. She'd run into some of the characters from Vend-a-Friend, one of them would point out that Dr. Wondertainment isn't actually a real person, and Isabel would brush them off with a line about how weird the timelines are, haha, them's the jokes, folks. I ended up abandoning the overall idea but still wanted to do something about the weirdness of Dr. W's existence, and I knew from the beginning that V-a-F still needed to be included somehow as part of that.

Thank you both for your kind words and for creating such an awesome story! :D

item.title: Re: Good.
item.content:encoded:
Yes! Yes yes yes, that's very much what I was trying to codify here. The idea has always seemed to be out there, that Wondertainment is this nebulous thing that defies codification, and that may not even be able to understand itself since it, both as an individual and as a concept in general, has been pulled in so many directions over the years. That maybe, just maybe, the ambiguity exists not because of a lack of hard information, but because the entity itself is ambiguous.

"There Is No Canon", I feel personally, is both exemplified and personified in Dr. Wondertainment him/her/itself.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
This was really fun.

I genuinely liked it. At first I was against the opening, like some others, but now I've changed my mind, simply because that transition from "lol, dis mary sue shit" to "wait, what? it's self aware? okay, maybe there's more to this" was pretty nice.

HOWEVER, despite all this, it doesn't work as a 001 article. 001 is (mostly) for entities that affect the Foundation, Humanity or Reality in some way. Usually something related to their origin or destruction. Some uncomfortable truth about it all. This is just… Wondertainment!

It would probably work fine as a Tale, but not as a 001. I also say it should be a Tale, because Dr. Wondertainment just being a regular mainlister would be too underwhelming. The idea is somewhere in-between 001 and regular mainlist, an area which doesn't currently exist on the wiki. The only alternative, would be a Tale.

Also: Despite what others may have implied, your writing doesn't seem "shitty" at all. I would even say it's above average. Nice imagery, excellent word choice, well paced, etc. That part's fine. The only issue is the concept doesn't cover what a 001 requires.

Hell! I love this as Wondertainment's attempt to hack themselves into being 01. That may have been what you are going for. but the article should not be an 01 proposal. Slap a "foundation tec staff found this article in the 01 slot with no evidence of it's origin or providence, research is ongoing to the meathods by which it was implanted into the SCP database behind the strictest firewalls" stlye comment at the bottom (or top) and make it a tale.

Great writing, fun, but no vote for me.

Folks have got their reasons for liking or disliking this article, and they've a right to 'em no matter what those reasons are. Let's try to keep the discussion focused on how terrible my story is rather than on how terrible the readers are for allowing it to continue existing.
